column2:
tḥibbīni?
EN: do you love me?
ـني -ni — me (after a verb)

abi anām
EN: I want to sleep
أبي + verb

tibīn tākilīn?
EN: do you want to eat?
تبين + verb (to her)

widdi ashūfik
EN: I'd love to see you
ودي + verb

banām
EN: I'm going to sleep
ب + verb = future

gāʿid ashtaghil
EN: I'm working (right now)
قاعد + verb = right now

ma adri → madri
EN: I don't know
ما + verb

māni fāhim
EN: I'm not getting it
ماني + adjective

la tizʿalīn
EN: don't be upset (to her)
لا + verb = don't!

ma fīh mushkila
EN: there's no problem
ما فيه

tawwni ṣiḥēt
EN: I just woke up
توّ + ending — taww-

ma baʿad akalt
EN: I haven't eaten yet
ما بعد — ma baʿad
